replicated_originals.reference: Imel, Barco, Brown, Baucom, Baer, Kircher & Atkins (2014) The association of therapist empathy and synchrony in vocally encoded arousal

A.reason: This is Imel et al. (2014b): 'we sought to replicate the study by Imel et al. (2014b)', testing whether session- and minute-level clinician-patient F0 synchrony is higher in high-empathy sessions, in two Swiss French samples. Title, authors, journal and DOI match the reference list.

B.reason: This is Imel et al. (2014a). It is cited only as background, on situational empathy variance and on standardized-patient performance being consistent with performance with real patients, and as the source of comparison MISC empathy means. None of its findings is replicated.

notes: The paper is a secondary analysis of audio from two independent Swiss studies (Gaume et al., 2014; Carrard et al., 2018). These are new samples relative to the original, so it is a replication (likely close extension), not a reanalysis of the original data. The authors frame the result as a failure to replicate.
